- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:714-721 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In heal_impl_repro_check, a failed repro-tree transfer used to exit 42 with out_of_heal_scope; now every failure exits 43 with repro_tree_unavailable. The scope checks in review_untrusted_workspace.py transfer() (line 461, lines 483-484, line 486) raise "out of heal scope", printed as reason=out_of_heal_scope (lines 990 and 996). This call sends stderr to /dev/null, so that reason is lost. The gate-tree transfer at lines 309-313 only logs gate_tree_unavailable, so line 718 is the first check that stops the run, and the host transfer at line 736 is never reached.
  WHY: An out-of-scope heal exits 43, and implement.yml runs `implement_heal_preflight.sh refuse repro_not_fixed`, posting "Outcome: `unverified`, Reason: `repro_tree_unavailable`". The operator is told this was an infrastructure problem and may re-approve. This breaks the issue's constraint that exit codes and refusal reasons stay unchanged. Suggested fix: send stderr to "${root}/results/repro-transfer.err", exit 42 with the existing out_of_heal_scope line if it matches, and update agents.d/heal-implement-repro-check.md (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2).
